name: MPI Corporation
summary: MPI Corporation, established in 1995 and based in Zhubei, Taiwan, is a global entity engaged in the manufacturing, processing, maintenance, and trade of semiconductor production and testing equipment. The company's product line features a variety of probe cards, including cantilever, FCB, EVS, and osprey types. They also deliver specialized instruments for the optoelectronics, semiconductor, and laser sectors, such as point test equipment, photoelectric measurement sorting systems, and AOI (Automated Optical Inspection) equipment. Furthermore, MPI provides automated visual and LED inspection systems tailored for optical sensing, communications, and micro-display technologies. Their offerings extend to manual and automated probe systems, alongside RF probes, which are vital for applications like device characterization, power, RF and mmW testing, design verification, failure analysis, wafer-level reliability, silicon photonics, MEMS testing, and signal integrity. The company additionally supplies thermal temperature testing and thermal cycling systems. MPI serves a broad spectrum of industries, including semiconductor manufacturing, materials research, aerospace, automotive, fiber optic, and electronic components.
